explanation: Choose every possible left-subtree size, recursively generate the left and right shapes, and clone each pair into a new root. Independent cloned nodes ensure that different returned trees do not share mutable nodes. The wrapper serializes shapes for comparison.
timeComplexity: O(n Cn) construction time for the nth Catalan number Cn; wrapper serialization/sorting adds comparison overhead.
spaceComplexity: O(n Cn) space including returned trees and temporary subtree collections.
